summary.text: Bernie Satrom is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 12 (Jamestown) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Bernie Satrom's service as "House since 2017". The member page lists Bernie Satrom's committee assignments as including Government and Veterans Affairs (Vice Chair) and the Judiciary standing committees.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Bernie Satrom's occupation as President, Maranatha Custom Churches Inc..
It lists education as BS, Business Finance, Montana State University.
It lists these affiliations and civic roles: Civil Justice Task Force; Criminal Justice Task Force; Gideons Jail Ministry; Deacon, Temple Baptist Church.
Bernie Satrom is listed as married to Dianne with 4 children.
